rkyen yod de/dbang shes snga mas bzhag pa'i bag chags dbang shes yul gyi rnam ldan du dngos su skyed byed kyi nus pa de de'i dmigs rkyen yin pa'i phya

tei:div.tei:p: rkyen yod de/ dbang shes snga mas bzhag pa'i bag chags dbang shes yul gyi rnam ldan du dngos su skyed byed kyi nus pa de de'i dmigs rkyen yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i dmigs rkyen ma rtogs par 'di na kha cig gis phyi don gyi dmigs rkyen rtog par byed do/ /rmi lam/ rnam pa gcig tu dpe dang sbyar te bstan pa ni rmi lam na phyi don med kyang bag chags smin pa las don snang gi ye shes 'byung ba bzhin du sad pa'i skabs su'ang don med kyi shes pa bden par yod dau zhes smra'o| |ji ltar du/ rmi lam du gzugs gsal snang gi yid shes 'byung ba ji bzhin sad long la'ang de 'dra 'byung bar thal/ ma sad pa dang sad long gnyis la brten bcas kyi mig dbang med par 'dra ba'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs te/ mig med pa las gzhan pa'i rgyu la mi ltos pas so/ kho na re/ ma khyab ste/ mig med pas min gyi gnyid rkyen gyis nus pa smin ma smin gyi khyad par las sad ma sad la gzugs gsal snang blo skye mi skye'i khyad par grub bo zhe na/ gal te/ sad long la gzugs gsal snang gi yid shes skye ba'i nus pa smin pa med pa ltar rmi lam na'ang de 'dra'i nus pa smin pa med par thal/ de yod pa'i sgrub byed tshig tsam du zad pa'i phyir/ ji ltar/ der thal/ mig med pa sad long la gzugs gsal snang gi nus pa smin pa'i rgyu min pa ltar rmi lam du'ang de 'dra'i rgyu nyid med pa'i phyir te/ nus pa de'ang skye ba nyid la mi ltos pa'i phyir/

de phyir/ rmi lam du'ang ye shes rdzun pa dang de skye byed kyi rgyu rdzun pa khas blangs par rigs te| shes pa de rgyu las skye shing*/ rgyu 'bras de gnyis bden pa la skyon yod pa'i phyir| 'di yis （ 16na ） sems tsam pas rnam rig tsam sgrub pa'i phyir du bkod pa'i sgrub byed thams cad dgag par nus te/ de'i sgrub byed du gang bkod kyang tshul gsum med pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas/ der ma zad sangs rgyas rang lugs la rnam rig ston pa'i lung yang med de/ sangs rgyas rang lugs don med kyi gzhan dbang dang yongs grub sogs bden par ston pa'i lung med pa'i phyir/ lang gshegs kyis ston no zhe na/ des de mi 'grub bo/ /yul med kyi shes pa bden grub med na bsgoms stobs kyis sa gzhi keng rus kyis gang bar gsal bar snang ba'i shes pa skye ba mi 'thad par 'gyur ro zhe na/ rnal 'byor/ sa gzhi keng rus gyi gang bar gsal snang gi blo chos can/ khyod yod na yul med kyi shes pa bden grub yod mi dgos par thal/ khyod dang khyod kyi yul dbang gsum ga bden par med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ khyod log pa yid byed du bshad pa ltar grub pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi chos can/ sngon po gcig du mas mthong ba ltar ting nge 'dzin mi sgom pa'i rgyud la'ang khyod skye ba srid par thal/ khyod rang rgyu ting nge 'dzin sgom pa la ltos med du skye ba srid pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ bden grub tu 'gal lo/ /de ni/ chos can/ khyod la snang ba ltar grub par thal/ khyod bden grub kyi blo yin pa'i phyir/ skrar snang lta bu'i shes pa gzhan skye bas ma nges so zhe na| rab rib/ skrar snang lta bu'i shes pa gzhan skye bas yul med kyi shes pa bden grub yod par mi 'grub par thal/ de lta bu'i shes pa chu klung rnag 'dzin gyi blo sogs bden par grub pa bshad zin gyi rigs pas khegs pa'i phyir/ mdor na/ don med kyi shes pa bden grub mi srid par thal/

don shes gnyis ka rang bzhin gyis med par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ gal te/ gnyis stong gi shes pa bden grub yod par khas len pa mi 'thad de/ de 'dra'i shes pa med par thal/ de 'dra shes pa 'jal byed med pa'i phyir te/ de 'dra de rang las don gzhan pa'i shes pas kyang mi 'jal/ 'di dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i shes pas kyang mi 'jal ba'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma grub stai/ rang rig gis 'jal lo zhe na/ de nyid/ rang rig gis gnyis stong gi shes pa mi 'jal bar thal/ rang rig med pa'i phyir| gal te/ dran pa'i rtags las rang rig 'grub bo zhe na/ ma grub/ de mi 'grub bar thal/ rang rig sgrub byed kyi rtags yang dag tu gyur pa'i dran pa med pa'i phyir/ rtags （ 16ba ） su bkod pa'i dran pa bden grub yin min dpyad pa'i tshe rang rig sgrub pa'i rtags yang dag tu gyur pa'i dran pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ sgra mi rtag sgrub la mig gi bzung bya bkod pa bzhin/ ma grub ces pa bsgrub bya sgrub nus su ma grub pa la sbyar gyi/ phyogs chos ma grub pa gcig pu la ma sbyar ro| |rang rig /rang rig yod du chug shes bya chos can/ lhas sbyin gyi rgyud la yul myong rjes su ngas yul mthong snyam pa'i dran pa skye ba mi 'thad par thal/ de'i rgyud kyi de 'dra'i dran pa dang de'i rgyud kyi yul myong gi shes pa rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ dper na byams pas myong ba las nyer sbas kyi rgyud la de dran pa mi 'byung ba bzhin/ kho na re/ dpe don mi mtshungs te/ rgyud gcig dang tha dad kyi khyad par yod do zhe na/ gtan tshigs/ lha sbyin gyi myong dran de gnyis chos can/ rgyud gcig tu mi rung bar thal/ rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyed rang la'ang rgyud gcig pa dang yul gcig pa mi rung bar thal ba de mtshungs te/ shes bya chos can/ lhas sbyin gyi rgyud la yul myong rjes su de dang rgyu gcig pa'i ngas yul mthong snyam pa'i dran pa skye bar mi 'thad par thal|

lhas sbyin gyi rgyud kyi yul myong gi shes pa dang ngas yul mthong snyam pa'i dran pa rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ rang 'grel gyi don la/ khyod kyi ltar na'ang ji ltar yin te mtshungs so zhe na/ zhes bya'o/ /gang phyir/ lhas sbyin chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi yul myong dang ngas yul mthong snyam pa'i dran pa rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod kyi rgyud la yul myong rjes su de dang rgyud gcig pa'i ngas yul mthong snyam pa'i dran pa skye bar mi 'gal bar thal/ rgyu mtshan de ma grub pa'i phyir/ mdor na thal ba de gnod byed du mi 'jug ste rtags ma grub kyi lan thebs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'o/ /'di yang*/ yul myong las yul can dran pa skye ba chos can/ btags pa tsam du grub ste/ khyod yod| khyod dpyad na med pa'i phyir/ shes bya chos can/ rtags phyi ma der thal/ myong dran de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'am rang gzhan gyis gzhan du gyur pa'i sgo nas skye ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ rang rig chos can/ khyod kyis don snang gi shes pa mi 'jal bar thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir/ byed po/ chos can dang*| chos sngar/ khyod yod na bya byed las gsum gcig tu 'gyur dgos pa gang zhig /de khegs pa'i phyir/ gal te/ mo gsham gyi bu 'gog mi rigs （ 17na ） par thal/ sgrub byed med kyang yod par bzhag nus pa'i phyir/ gang tshe| gnyis stong gi shes pa bden grub chos can/ khyod kun btags su 'khrul rtog gi gzhi min par thal/ khyod med pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi/ rnam rig pa chos can| bstan bcos dang 'jig rten la grags pa'i kun rdzob thams cad la skur ba btab par thal/ phyi rol gyi don med par khas len pa'i phyir/ don med na gzhan dbang gi shes pa nyid kyang mi srid do/ /des na mngon mtho las nyams so/ /slob dpon chos can/ khyod kyis thar lam ma rnyed par thal/ khyod bden gnyis rtogs pa las nyams pa gang zhig

/de las nyams na de srid du thar pa sgrub thabs med pa'i phyir/ tha snyad/ rtags dang po der thal/ stong nyid bstan pa rtogs pa las stong nyid rtogs dgos pa gang zhig stong nyid bstan pa mi rtogs pa'i phyir te/ phyi don med pas rjod byed sogs med pa'i phyir/ thabs ni yi ge med pa'i zhes sogs drangs nas rjod byed la rang bshad do/ /de gnyis rtags gnyis par thal/ de srid du rtags chad kyi lta ba'i dbang gis thar lam las log par bzhugs pa'i phyir/ des na nges legs mi srid do/ kho na re/ dbu ma pa chos can/ gzhan dbang bkag pa'i nyes pa thams cad khyod rang la yod par thal/ khyod kun rdzob bden grub tu khas mi len pa'i phyir/ nyes pa ni mngon mtho nges legs mi srid pa'o/ /ji ltar chos can/ thal ba de khyod la gnod byed du ma 'jug par thal/ rgyal bas gdul bya drang ba'i phyir du kun rdzob bden grub yod par gsungs par bstan gyi/ rang lugs la de 'dra m-i bzhed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar/ chos can/ gzugs sogs phyi don khas len par rigs pa'i khyod kyi lhag med kyi 'dod tshul ltar gzugs sogs/ phyi don med na 'gogs rigs kyang*/ ltos grub kyi de 'dra tha snyad pa'i tshad mas grub pa'i phyir| gal te/ chos can/ khyod kyis phyi don 'gog par mi rigs te/ bkag pa la gnod byed med na 'gog rigs kyang*/ de la tha snyad pa'i tshad mas gnod pa'i phyir/ khyod dang chos can/ gzugs sogs phyi rol gyi kun rdzob 'jog par rigs te/ de yod pa tha snyad pa'i tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ rnam rig bkag na lung dang 'gal te/ sa bcu par khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam ste zhes sogs kyi lung gis sa drug pa bas phyi don med pa'i shes pa bden grub rtogs （ 17ba ） par bstan pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ mngon 'gyur/ sa bcu pa'i lung de chos can/ khyod kyis sa drug pa bas rnam rig gi tshul rtogs par bstan pa'i sgo nas rnam rig pa bkag pa la lung 'gal med par thal/

khyod kyis sa drug pa bas bdag srid rgyu ma yin zhing bdag 'dzin srid rgyu yin par rtogs par bstan gyi de ltar ma bstan pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ gang zag rgyun dang phung po dang*/ zhes sogs kyi lang gshegs kyi lung de chos can/ khyod gsungs pa dgos pa yod de/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam ste zhes pa'i lung don gsal bar bya ba'i phyir du khyod gsungs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar gsal bar byas zhe na/ ji bzhin/ chos can| khyod kyis lung de'i don gsal bar ston te/ khyod kyis bdag srid rgyu ma yin pa dang*/ bdag 'dzin srid rgyu yin par gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ zhes sam| chos can/ khyod kyi bstan don yod de/ rtag pa'i bdag dang bdag 'dzin srid rgyu yin min gyi khyad par de khyod kyi bstan don yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid/ khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam ste zhes pa'i lung de chos can/ khyod kyis rnam rig tsam bstan pa'i sgo nas rnam rig pa bkag pa la lung 'gal gyi skyon med par thal/ khyod kyis gzugs sems gnyis srid rgyu'i gtso bo yin min gyi khyad par bstan gyi de ltar ma bstan pa'i phyir/ gal te/ sa bcu par rnam shes rten 'byung dang ngo bo nyid med pa sogs su gsungs pa ltar mi 'thad par thal/ sa bcu par rnam shes bden par gsungs pa ltar grub pa'i phyir/ sems nyid/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten chos can/ rang rgyu sems las skye ste/ rang rgyu thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i las kyi skyed pa'i phyir/ sems spangs/ las las skye na sems las skye bas khyab ste/ bden par zhen pa'i sems kyis las dngos su skye ba'i phyir dang*/ sems dang sems pa mtshungs ldan yin pa'i phyir/ las rgyur ston pa'i lung ni/ sems can las kyi dbang gis ri zhes sogs so/ / yang na lung de chos can/ bstan don la mi slu ste/ dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa'i phyir/ sa sa phyi ma 'dra'o/

/gal te/ nyer len gyi phung po chos can/ gzugs khyod kyi rgyu'igatso bo min te/ gzugs med kyang khyod 'byung ba srid pa'i phyir| shes bya chos can/ rtags der thal/ bem po med kyang 'byung ba'i sa bon yod pa'i phyir/ sems gtso bo lung don yin pa ni sa bcu pa'i sems gcig la brten zhes （ 18na ） pa'i gcig la zhes pa grub bo/ /des na/ khams gsum zhes sogs kyi lung de chos can/ khyod kyis rnam rig tsam bstan pa'i sgo nas lung 'gal gyi skyon med par thal/ khyod kyis bdag sogs byed po yin pa bkag gi phyi don ma bkag pa'i phyir dang*/ 'jig rten/ tha snyad du don sems kyi phung po lnga char yod de/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ de nyid don dam du de lnga char med de/ de slob ma'i mnyam bzhag gi gzigs ngor med pa'i phyir/ gzugs| don dang don snang dbang shes yod med khyad par 'dzin par mi rigs te/ don med na don snang dbang shes kyang med la dbang shes yod na don kyang yod dgos pa'i phyir te/ rgyu 'bras yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs pa'i sgrub byed bshad zin nas lung gi ni/ de dag don sems don dam par med par ston pa'i lung yod de/ sher phyin gyi mdor de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ mngon| de tha snyad du yod par ston byed kyi lung yod de/ mngon pa'i mdor de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ bden/ bden gnyis dang 'gal ba'i rnam rig bsgrubs par don med par thal/ de bkag zin pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ don sems don dam par med cing tha snyad du yod par khas len rigs te/ bden gnyis kyi rnam gzhag dang 'gal na tshad mas gnod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ rnam rig gi tshul grub te/ phyi rol snang ba yod med de/ /zhes sogs kyis rnam rig tsam bstan pa'i phyir zhe na/ mdo sde/ lung de chos can/ khyod kyis rnam rig tsam bstan pas rnam rig tsam mi 'grub par thal/ khyod phyi rol la brten pa'i nyon mongs dgag pa'i phyir du phyi don yod kyang med pa ltar ston pa'i drang don gyi lung yin pa'i phyir/

'di ni/ lung de chos can/ khyod drang don gyi lung yin te/ khyod de ltar lung rigs kyis grub pa'i phyir/ lung gis sgrub pa ni/ rnam pa/ lung de chos can| khyod dang lung gzhan drang don du lung gis bstan te/ khyod dang dgongs 'grel gyi ngo bo nyid gsum bstan pa'i lung sogs drang don du lang gshegs kyi lung gis bstan pa'i phyir/ rigs pas sgrub pa ni shes bya/ sangs rgyas chos can| gdul bya 'ga' zhig la stong nyid ston pa'i sngar phyi don med par gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de la phyi don med par bstan pa stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur bas de la de'i sngar de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de la de bstan pa de'i thabs su 'gyur te/ yul stong pa （ 18ba ） rtogs na yul can stong par rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ shes bya/ rtags de grub ste/ yul stong par rtogs yul can stong par rang gzhan gang rung la brten nas tshegs chung ngus rtogs nus pa'i phyir| dang por/ des na/ shes bya zhes pa snga ma'i chos can dang chos sbyar nas gdul bya 'ga' zhig stong nyid la 'khrid pa'i ched du de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'dus byas mi rtag par ston pa'i mdo chos can/ drang don gyi mdo yin te| stong nyid dngos su mi ston par stong nyid rtogs pa'i thabs ston pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir ram/ khyod kyi bstan don go bas stong nyid rtogs pa la rgyud nas 'jug pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/ stong nyid/ phung po lnga po 'di dag kyang rang bzhin gyis stong par lta'o zhes pa'i mdo chos can/ nges don gyi mdo yin te/ stong nyid dngos su ston pa las brtsams pa'i mdo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis las/ phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ bdag gzhan gnyis las mi skye ste/ de la bdag gzhan re res las skye ba la dgag pa rgyas par bshad pa rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ 'di ni/ chos can/ chos 'dra/ de las skye ba bden gnyis gang rung du bsdus nas 'gog pa'i rigs pas khegs pa'i phyir/

gang phyir/ chos can| khyod kyi rgyur bdag gzhan gnyis mi dgos te/ bdag gzhan re re la khyod skyed pa'i nus pa cung zad kyang med pa'i phyir/ bye ma gcig la til mar 'byin pa'i nus pa med na changs po la'ang med pa bzhin no/ /ngo bo nyid rgyur smra ba na re/ dngos po thams cad rgyu med du 'byung bas gong gi skyon rnams med do zhe na/ gal te/ bya rog chos can/ rma bya'i mdongs skye bar thal/ de rgyu med du skye ba'i phyir/ yang*/ rma bya chos can/ khyod mngal na yod pa'i gnas skabs su'ang khyod la sgro ne ljang yod par thal/ sgro ne ljang rgyu med du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten pa chos can/ lo tog 'byung ched du 'bad rtsol mi dgos par thal/ de rgyu med du skye ba'i phyir/ gal te/ myu gu chos can/ khyod rang rgyu las skye ste/ khyod kyi rgyu med na khyod med dgos pa las/ khyod tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ rang rgyud kyi sngon 'dzin mngon sum sngon po yod na skye zhing med par mi skye ba bzhin/ tshu rol mdzes pa'i rgyang 'phen pa na re/ 'jig rten pha rol mngon sum gyis ma mthong bas med par grub mod/ da ltar mngon sum du mthong bzhin pa'i 'jig rten 'di 'byung ba bzhi'i nyer len

（ 19na ） las skye'o zhes smra'o/ /'byung ba/ tshu rol mdzes pa pa chos can/ 'jig rten pha rol med pa mngon sum gyis ma rtogs par thal/ 'jig rten 'di'i gnas tshul la rmongs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'jig rten 'di 'byung ba'i nyer len las skye bar 'dzin pa gang zhig de ltar ma grub pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten/ chos can/ 'jig rten pha rol med lta ma spangs pa de srid du lta ngan can du thal/ de srid du 'jig rten pha rol la skur 'debs kyi lta ba la mngon 'gyur rten dang 'dra ba'i lus can yin pa'i phyir/ 'byung ba bden par zhen pa yod pa'i dus bzhin no/ kho na re/ dpe ma grub de'i 'byung ba bden 'dzin pa dag pa'i blo'o zhe na/ min te/ 'byung ba rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i phyir| de sgrub dgos so/ /da dung dpe ma grub bo zhe na/ 'byung ba shes bya chos can| 'byung ba rang bzhin gyis skye med du gsar du sgrub mi dgos par thal/ de gong du grub zin pa'i phyir/ gang gi der thal/ gong du bden skye spyir bkag pa'i sgo nas de grub zin pa'i phyir/ phyogs chos bsgrubs zin to/ khyab pa ni/ rgyu lnga pa med pa'i phyir grub pa/ /des na rtags dgod pa ni/ gang gi phyi nang gi dngos po rnams chos can/ rang bzhin gyis skye ba med de/ mtha' bzhi gang rung las mi skye ba'i phyir/ kho na re/ mngon sum gyis sngo sogs kyi rang bzhin ma mthong bar thal| dngos po kun rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thams cad kyi mngon sum la sngo sogs kyi rang bzhin snang bar mngon gsum du mthong ba dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na/ gang phyir/ stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i gang zag chos can/ khyod kyis sngo sogs kyi rang bzhin ma mthong bar thal/ khyod kyi gti mug gis sngo sogs kyi rang bzhin mthong ba bsgribs nas de las log par mthong ba'i phyir/ dper na sprin mthug pos nam mkha' bsgribs pa bzhin no/ kho na re/ sgrib byed kyi tshul ji bzhin du mi mthong yang log par mthong bar mi byed do zhe na/

ji ltar/ shes bya chos can/ sgrib byed kyi dbang gis log par snang ba yod de/ rab rib kyis bsgribs pas skra shad 'dzag snang sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ de bzhin/ gti mug gi dbang gis log par snang ste/ gti mug gi dbang gis lta ba mi shes pa'i gang zag 'dus byas bden par zhen pa'i phyir/ gal te/ rtags der thal/ 'du byed gti mug gi rjes su （ 19ba ） 'gro ldog byed par gsungs pa'i lung don la brten nas dngos smra ba 'du byed bden par zhen nas 'khor bar 'ching zhing*/ gti mug shin tu srab pa kha cig rten 'brel gyi tshig tsam thaus pas log zhen spangs te grol bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan yod pa'i phyir/ gal te/ kho na re/ sngo sogs tha snyad du'ang bden par mi snang bar thal/ de bden par med pa'i phyir/ thal ba las/ sngo sogs chos can/ don dam par yod par thal/ bden par tha snyad pa'i tshad mas grub pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni tha snyad pa'i tshad ma la sngo sogs rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa snang zhing de la de tshad mar song bar 'dod pa dngos smra ba spyi'i rtsod pa'o/ /yang dag dngos smra bas chos de bden par gsal bar mi snang bar thal/ de bden par med pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can| khyod dbu ma pa la 'phangs par mi rigs par thal/ khyod gzhan la rtsod rigs kyi thal 'gyur yin na skra shad yod par gsal bar snang zhen can gyi gang zag dang*/ lta ba ma rtogs pa'i gang zag la snga phyir 'phang bar rigs kyi/ dbu ma pa la gnod byed min pa'i phyir/ dang po grub te/ gang zag de dag gis lan mi thebs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub te/ dbu ma pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas lan 'debs la/ rnal 'byor pa la brtsad bya min pa'i phyir te/ rnal 'byor pas bden grub mi snang bar bden med gzigs pa'i phyir/ re zhig dang phyi nas zhes pa'i nus pa 'don na/ gzhan la rtsod rigs la rtsod pa'i go rim yang snga phyi'i 'di ltar rigs zhes pa ste/

chos can/ chos de bden par med na de bden par snang ba 'gal ba'i rtsod pa bden grub tu yod par bden zhen can gyi gang zag la dang por brtsad nas phyis bden med ma rtogs pa'i gang zag la brtsad rigs par thal/ khyod de ltar rtsod pa po gang zhig rtsod pa gnyis snga ma ches gsal zhing rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ gal te/ thal ba 'di ni khyod la rang 'jug te/ shes bya chos can/ chos de bden med du mtshungs kyang chos de bden par mi snang bar mi mtshungs par thal/ rmi lam bden par med kyang bden par mthong ba'i phyir/ zhes so/ /yang na rmi lam chos can/ tha snyad du'ang 'dzin par mi snang bar thal/ bden par med pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ dngos smra ba la gnod byed du thal/ des bzlog mi nus pa'i thal 'gyur yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid/ sngo sogs chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir| zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ dbu ma pa la （ 20na ） gnod byed min par thal/ des khyab med kyi lan thebs pa'i phyir/ mo gsham/ 'gro ba dag ni rmi lam 'drar bshad ces sogs kyi lung snga ma la sbyar ba'am/ yang na lung don de las gzugs sogs rang bzhin gyis ma skyes par grub pas/ gzugs sogs chos can/ bden par grub par thal/ tha snyad pa'i tshad mas bden par grub pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal ba ni khyed rang la 'jug gi kho bo la mi 'jug te/ thal 'gyur de chos can/ dbu ma pa la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur min par thal/ des rtags ma grub kyi lan gyis bzlog nus pa'i phyir te/ rtags khas ma blangs shing*| tshad mas ma grub pa'i phyir te/ mo gsham gyi bu ltar gzugs sogs bden pa gnyis char du rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ rtags lung dang sbyor ba ni| de phyir/ gzugs sogs rtag tu rang bzhin gyis skye ba med de/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa la dgongs nas ston pas/ gdod nas zhi zhing skyes pa zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/

khyad par du bye smras kyang de 'phang mi rigs pa ni/ bum sogs/ bum sogs chos can/ tha snyad du'ang mo gsham bu bzhin mi snang bar thal/ don dam par med pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can| bye smras dbu ma pa la 'phang bar mi rigs par thal/ dbu ma pa la khas blangs pa bzhin du chos thams cad don dam par med cing kun rdzob tu yod pa'i phyir| bum pa chos can zhes bye smra la 'phangs pa'i tshe de'i 'khor gsum ka bye smra rang gis khas blangs pa'i phyir/ nged kyis lan thebs cing bzlog na bye smras lan med pas mi rigs zhes pa'o/ kho na re/ skye ba med par thal/ mtha' bzhi gang rung gi skye ba med pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ gang phyir/ ma khyab par thal/ mtha' bzhi gang rung gis skye ba med pas bden skye med kyang brten nas btags pa tsam gyi skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ ltos med kyi skye ba med kyang ltos pa'i skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ gang phyir rten 'brel gyi don rtogs nas mtha' bzhi skye bar rtog pa sogs kyi kun btags kyi lta ngan mtha' dag mi 'byung ste/ chos thams cad brten nas btags pa tsam du rtogs na bden 'dzin kun btags ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rtog rnams/ bden 'dzin log na kun btags kyi lta ngan mtha' dag ldog par thal/ kun btags kyi lta ngan bden 'dzin kun btags kyi skyed pa'i phyir/ dper na me bud shing gis skyed pas bud shing log na me ldog pa bzhin/ so so/ klu sgrub chos （ 20ba ） can/ bden 'dzin spong ched du de kho nyid rig pas gtan la phab ste/ gdul bya grol ba thob phyir du de yin pa gang zhig bden 'dzin spangs pas grol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ bden 'dzin 'khor bar 'ching rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ bstan/ chos can/ rtsod pa lhur len gyi ched du bstan bcos su dgag sgrub byas pa min te/ bden 'dzin spangs nas grol ba'i grol ba'i ched du dgag sgrub byas pa'i phyir/

kho na re/ rtsod pa lhur len gyi ched du byas te/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos su dgag sgrub byas pas gzhan lugs 'jig pa'i phyir/ zhe na/ gal te chos can/ de nyid rnam par bshad pas gzhan lugs zhig kyang rtsod pa lhur len gyi nyes pa med de/ de kho na nyid dpyod pa'i rigs pas rnam par dpyad pas gzhan lugs zhar la zhig pa yin pa'i phyir| rang gi shes bya chos can/ rang gzhan gyi lta ba la chags sdang gi zhen na grol bar mi 'gyur te/ chags sdang de nyid 'ching byed kyi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ klu sgrub chos can/ gdul bya grol ched du de nyid gtan la phab ste/ rang gzhan gyis lta ba la chags sdang spangs te de kho nyid gtan la phab pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ngos bzung nas spong 'dod kyi rnal 'byor pa chos can| khyod kyis nyes bur 'jig lta'i rtsa ba can du shes shing 'jig lta'i dmigs yul gyi gnas tshul rtogs nas gang zag gi bdag dgag dgos te/ khyod thar pa don gnyer gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rim pa yang dang por gang zag gis bdag med pa gtan la 'bebs dgos so/ /'o na 'jig lta'i dmigs yul gyi bdag de ji lta bu zhe na/ za po/ grangs can ni phung po las don gzhan gyis gang zag rdzas yod bdag gi ngo bo dang*/ byed po min pa sogs mtshan nyid lnga bdag gi khyad chos su 'dod do/ /de dbye/ bye brag pa kha cig byed pa po sogs lnga ldan du 'dod cing*/ bye brag pa kha cig bya ba dang bcas pa'i lnga ldan dang*/ rig byed gsang ba pa/ bdag snod bcud thams cad la khyab par 'dod cing*/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyis de la dmigs nas ma skyes rtag sogs su 'dzin par 'dod do/ /mo gsham/ phung po las don gzhan gyi bdag chos can| de kho nar rdzas su med de/ ma skyes pa'i phyir/ rtags so/ /mo gsham gyi bu bzhin| 'di ni/ chos can/ de kho nar ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi dmigs yul ma yin te/

rtags dpe sngar ro/ /'di ni/ chos can/ kun rdzob tu'ang rdzas su （ 21na ） med de/ zhes dang*/ kun rdzon tu'ang ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi dmigs yul min te/ rtags dpe sngar ro/ /gang phyir/ phung po las don gzhan gyi gang zag rdzas yod chos can/ khyod la rtag dngos sogs kyi khyad chos lnga mi ldan te/ rtags dpe sngar/ de phyir/ phung po las ngo bo tha dad pa'i gang zag med de/ phung por ma btagasapa'i gang zag med pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ gang zag yin na 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang bdag chos can/ phung po las don gzhan du med de/ de yod na khyod yan gar du mthong ba srid dgos pa gang zhig de mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po ni bum snam ltar 'gyur dgos pas so/ /tshig gsal ltar 'dir gnyis byed pa 'grel pa'i don no| |'jig rten/ shes bya chos can/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes yin na gang zag ma skyes rtag gcig sogs su 'dzin pas ma khyab ste/ brda la ma byang ba'i rgyud la gang zag ma skyes rtag gcig sogs su 'dzin pa med pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ ma grub ste/ sngon de ltar 'dzin pa goms stobs kyis da ltar yang 'byung ngo zhe na/ gang dag sems can yin na ma skyes rtag gcig tu 'dzin pa'i blo goms stobs kyi 'byung bas ma khyab par thal/ bskal ba mang por dud 'gro sogs kyi skye ba bar med du brgyud de de 'dra'i blo ma goms pa srid pa'i phyir/ des na phung po las don gzhan gyi gang zag gi rdzas yod mtshan nyid lnga ldan mi srid de/ de yod pa la khas blangs dang rigs pas gnod pa'i phyir/ phung po/ mang bkur pa'i sde pa na re/ phung po 'jig lta'i dmigs yul yin te/ de'i dmigs yul gyi bdag yod phung po las don gzhan gyi bdag med pa'i phyir/ nang tshan kha cig na re/ phung po lnga de'i bdag yin te/ mdo las bdag go snyam du lta ba ni phung po lnga po kho na la lta'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/

ngar 'dzin lhan skyes la 'jig tshogs la lta ba zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ nang tshan kha cig rnam shes de'i bdag yin te/ bdag 'dul byar bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ phung po las don gzhan pa'i 'dul bya'i bdag med cing*/ mdo gzhan du sems 'dul byar yang bshad pa'i phyir/ des na ngar 'dzin gyi 'jig lta ni phung po la dmigs nas nga'o snyam du 'dzin no zhes smra'o/ /gal te bdag chos can/ khyod du mar thal/ phung po lnga dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtags ni khas blangs te/ phung po dang ngo bo （ 21ba ） gcig na gcig tu 'gyur te/ de lta na de gnyis rtog pa la ngo bo tha dad du snang ba mi srid pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub pas so/ /gzhan yang*/ chos can/ chos sngar/ khyod rnam shes lnga dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ yang na chos can| chos sngar/ yid shes kyi cha shas kyi skad cig du ma dang gcig pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ ye shes dang gcig yin zhing ye shes de rang gi cha shas kyi skad cig du ma dang gcig yin pa 'gal lo/ /yang na ji ltar rigs par brjod ces 'byung bas/ lhas sbyin chos can/ khyod la gang zag rgyud tha dad pa du ma yod par thal| khyod la gang zag snga phyi du ma yod/ snga phyi'i gang zag rgyud tha dad yin pa'i phyir| rtags gnyis khas/ yang phung po du ma gcig tu thal ba'ang 'phang ngo*/ / 'dod na/ 'jig rten skye ba na gang zag nyag cig skye'o zhes 'dod pa dang 'gal lo| |bdag ni/ gang zag rdzas yod du thal/ phung po rdzas yod yin pa'i phyir/ gsum mo/ /bsal pa gang zag btags yod du khyod rang gi lung las bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /der lta/ 'jig lta chos can/ 'dzin stangs la ma 'khrul bar thal| khyod kyis gang zag rdzas yod du bzung*/ de ltar grub pa'i phyir/ dang po rtsa ba'i khas len/ gnyis pa'ang khas blangs te/ phung po rdzas yod yin/ bdag phung gcig yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mthong lam gyis slar mi skye ba'i tshul gyi spong bar 'dod pa dang 'gal lo/

/mya ngan/ lhag med kyi myang 'das thob pa'i tshe gang zag rgyun chad par thal/ de'i tshe phung po rgyun chad pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags/ 'dod na/ mang bkur ba chos can/ khyod chad pa'i mthar lta can du thal/ de'i tshe bdag yod pa gang zhig khyod kyis de'i tshe bdag med par 'dzin pa'i phyir| khyab pa ni 'jig ltas gang du bzung ba'i don de nyid rtag chad du 'dzin pa mthar lta gnyis su 'dod pa dang 'gal lo/ /mya ngan/ shes bya chos can/ bdag snga phyi ngo bo nyid kyis skye 'jig so sor byed par thal/ phung po snga phyi de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab/ 'dod na/ skye ba dran pa mi srid par thal/ tshe snga phyi'i bdag gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ rtags/ byed po/ las byed pa pos las kyi 'bras bu myong bar mi srid par thal/ las byas rjes su las byed pa po med pa'i phyir/ bdag snga phyi rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab ste/ bdag snga mas byas pa'i las 'bras bdag phyi mas myong ngo zhe na/ gzhan/ las ma byas pa dang phrad （ 22na ） pa srid par thal/ phyogs snga gang zhig byed dus dang myong dus kyi bdag gnyis rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ de nyid/ kho na re/ thal ba phyi ma rnams ma khyab ste| bdag snga phyi rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin kyang rgyud gcig pas so zhe na/ sngar| bdag snga phyi chos can/ rgyud gcig pa ma yin par thal/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i tha dad pa'i phyir/

de phyir/ phung po lnga dang sems bdag yin pa mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar khas blangs pa la lung rigs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten/ bdag chos can/ khyod kyi mtha' med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod mtha' ldan du lung ma bstan pa min par thal/ khyod kyi mtha' yod pa'i phyir te/ phung po mtha' ldan yin pa'i phyir/ gsum mo/ /gzhan yang phung po ngo bo nyid kyis skye 'jig byed cing*/ tshe snga phyir yang skye 'jig byed pas bdag kyang de ltar 'gyur bas bdag de dang der rgyun chad pa'i mi rtag par 'gyur ro/ /de lta/ bdag chos can/ khyod rgyun chad pa'i mi rtag pa min pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod mi rtag par lung zhes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa grong phan chad 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi 'byung bar lung zhes dang*/ lus de nyid srog min pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis lus de nyid srog tu lung zhes sbyar ro/ /'grel par snga ma gsum las med kyang sbyar rung bar 'dra'o/ khyod kyi/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chos can/ khyod kyis phung po med par rtogs par thal/ khyod kyis bdag med par rtogs pa'i phyir/ khyab rtags/ rtag bdag kho na re/ rtags ma grub ste/ phung po bdag tu bzhag pa ni las 'bras kyi rten yin gyi dgag bya'i bdag min pas rnal 'byor pas de med par ma rtogs la| rnal 'byor pas med par rtogs rgyu ni dgag bya'i bdag rtag gcig sogs su gyur pa nang gi byed pa'i skyes bu'o zhe na/ de tshe/ las 'bras kyi rten gyi bdag btags don btsal nas bzhag pa min par thal/ las 'bras kyi rten gyi bdag de dgag bya'i bdag min pa'i phyir/ khyod kyi/ bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chos can/ khyod la nyon mongs spong lam med par thal/ khyod kyis gzugs kyi de kho na nyid ma rtogs pa'i phyir te/ bdag btags tsam du ma rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtags so/ /dper na ze 'bru la khu byug yod par shes kyang ze 'bru'i ro ma myang na ro zhim po med 'dzin spong mi nus pa bzhin no/

/ （ 22ba ） gzugs la/ chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la nyon mongs slar 'phel bar 'gyur bar thal| khyod kyi rgyud la nyon mongs spong ba'i rgyu med cing*/ 'phel rgyu yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i de kho na nyid ma rtogs par de la bden par zhen pa'i phyir/ dper na ze 'bru la khu byug med par shes kyang ro zhim po myangs na chags pa skye ba bzhin no/ khu na re/ ma dhu zhes pa sbrang rtsi la 'jug pas 'gyur nor zer ro/ / de bden pa 'dra ste/ nag 'gyur du/ 'ga' zhig gis sbrang rtsi mngar ba nyid ma myangs par sbrang rtsi'i nang na ko ki la med do zhes bya ba de tsam gyis sbrang rtsi len par byed na'ang des sbrang rtsi mngar ba nyid myong ba ni ma yin zhes 'byung ngo*/ / gang phyir/ mang bkur ba na re/ phung po lnga bdag yin te/ ston pas bdag go snyam du yang dag par rjes su lta ba de ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di dag kho na la yang dag par rjes su lta'o zhes pa'i lung gis phung po lnga bdag tu bstan pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ lung de'-i bstan don med par 'gyur ro zhe na/ de ni/ lung de chos can/ khyod kyi phung po bdag tu mi ston kyang khyod kyi bstan don yod de| khyod kyi phung po las don gzhan pa'i bdag 'jig lta'i dmigs pa yin pa bkag nas btags tsam gyi bdag 'jig lta'i dmigs par bstan pa'i phyir/ gzugs bdag lung chos can/ khyod kyi phung po so so ba bdag tu mi ston te/ de ston na mdo gzhan du phung po so so ba bdag yin pa mi 'gog dgos pa gang zhig gzhan du de bkag pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ rtags phyi mar thal/ gzhan du phung po lnga po re re nas bdag min par gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir/ lung de chos can/ phung po bdag yin pa khyod kyi bstan don ma yin te/ de yin na mdo gzhan dang 'gal ba'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang phung po lnga bdag yin pa lung de'i don yin na/ phung lnga tshogs pa bdag tu thal/

phung lnga bdag tu bstan pa gang zhig phung lnga so so ba dang re re nas bdag min pa'i phyir/ rtags phyi ma sngar/ bsgrubs zin to/ /'dod na/ phung lnga tshogs tsam mam phung lnga'i dbyibs khyad par dang ldan pa'i tshogs pa gang bdag yin/ dang po ltar na/ phung lnga tshogs pa chos can/ las bzang ngan bsags pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la phan gnod mi byed pa thal/ dngos po min pa'i phyir te/ phung po lnga dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung min pa'i phyir/ de med/ 'dod na/ chos can/ （ 23na ） bdag min par thal lo/ /rtags ma grub stai/ tshogs pa dang tshogs pa can rdzas gcig yin pa'i phyir 'bras bu skyed do zhe na/ sgra 'dod rgur mi rigs pa dang*/ dus du ma gcig tu thal ba'i nyes pa bshad zin cing*/ skyon gzhan yang*/ de tshe shing rta'i yan lag tshogs pa shing rtar thal/ phung po lnga tshogs tsam bdag yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste| bdag dang shing rta 'jug tshul mtshungs pa'i phyir/ mdo las/ bdag chos can| phung po tshogs pa khyod min par thal/ khyod phung po tshogs pa la brten nas btags pa'i phyir/ rten par gsungs pa ni/ ji ltar yan lag tshogs rnams la| |zhes sogs kyi mdo'o/ /dbyibs zhe na/ phung po lnga'i dbyibs khyad par ba dang ldan pa'i tshogs pa bdag yin no zhe na/ de gzugs/ shes bya/ chos can/ phung po lnga'i tshogs dbyibs khyad par can bdag min par thal/ de'i dbyibs med pa'i phyir te/ tshor sogs bzhi la dbyibs med pa'i phyir/ len po/ las dang byed po gcig tu thal/ len po dang blang bya gcig yin pa'i phyir/ rtags/ khyab ste/ len po byed po dang blang bya las yin pa'i phyir ro/ kho na re/ len po yod na skyon de yod kyang*/ blang bya tsam du zad kyi len po med do/ /mdor gang las byed pa po ni ma dmigs kyi las kyang yod la rnam par smin pa'ang yod do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ byed pa po las med par thal/ las su 'jog pa'i rgyu med pa'i phyir te/

byed po med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ byed po la ltos nas las su 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ bdag chos can/ phung po so so ba dang tshogs pa khyod min par thal/ khyod de la brten nas btags pa'i phyir/ brten par gsungs pa ni yab sras mjal ba'i mdo'o/ /de phyir/ phung po so so ba dang tshogs pa chos can/ 'jig lta'i dmigs yul min par thal/ bdag min pa'i phyir/ bdag med/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab chos can/ khyod 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi dngos gnyen min par thal/ khyod dang 'jig lta 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba ma yin pa'i phyir/ khyod rtag bdag med par dngos su 'dzin pa gang zhig rtag bdag 'jig lta lhan skyes kyi rnam pa'i yul min pa'i phyir/ rang khyim/ gzhi 'ga' zhig tu glang po med par rtogs pas sbrul gy-i 'jigs pa med par 'gyur bar thal/ glang po med kyang sbrul gyis zin pa （ 23ba ） srid pa'i phyir/ phung po/ bdag chos can/ khyod phung po dang rang bzhin gyis gzhan min te/ khyod phung po las rang bzhin gyis tha dad pa dang*/ phung po khyod las rang bzhin gyis tha dad pa gang rung min pa'i phyir te/ phan tshun yan gar du ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ nag tsho/ gang phyir/ chos can/ khyod phung po'i rten dang brten pa gang rung rang bzhin gyis med de/ de ltar yod na khyod phung po dang rang bzhin gyis gzhan yin dgos pa gang zhig de min pa'i phyir/ bdag ni/ bdag chos can/ khyod gzugs dang ldan pa rang bzhin gyis med de/ khyod gzugs dang ldan pa'i don rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ der thal| gzugs dang rang bzhin gyis ngo bo gcig dang tha dad gang rung du med pa'i phyir/ gzhan ni/ khyab ste/ ldan na ngo bo gcig dang tha dad kyi ldan tshul las ma 'das pa'i phyir/ lhas sbyin mig dang ldan lhas sbyin gnag dang ldan zhes pa bzhin| bdag ni/ rtags ma grub ste/ bdag phung rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gcig dang tha dad la gnod byed bshad zin pa'i phyir/

phung po ma gtogs de 'dzin zhes sogs dang*/ gal te phung po bdag na zhes sogs su'o/ / gzugs bdag shes bya chos can/ dmigs rnam log par bzhugs pa'i 'jig lta kun btags kyi cha nyi shu yod de/ phung lnga re re la dmigs nas bdag tu lta ba sogs grub mthas btags pa'i 'jig lta nyi shu yod pa gang zhig phung lnga re re nas bdag yin pa sogs su ma grub pa'i phyir/ lta ri/ phung lnga re re nas bdag tu lta ba sogs kyi 'jig lta kun btags nyi shu chos can/ mthong spang gi cha yin te/ grub mthas btags pa'i nga bden 'dzin dang lhan cig spong ba'i mthong spang yin pa'i phyir*/ gcig de nyid/ mang bkur ba kha cig na re/ bdag phung gcig dang tha dad gang rung yin na ji skad bshad pa'i skyon yod pa'i phyir/ gcig tha dad rtag mi rtag gang rung du brjod du med do/ /'on kyang phung po la ltos med kyi rdzas yod yin te/ phung po la dbang byed pa'i las byed pa po dang 'bras bu myong ba po dang 'khor 'das gnyis su bcings thar kyi gzhi yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam shes drug gang rung gi rtags las mthong ba po sogs su shes par bya bar yang 'dod cing*/ ngar 'dzin lhan skyes kyi dmigs yul du'ang grub bo zhes zer ro/ /gang phyir/ bdag chos can/ phung po dang rdzas dang gcig tha dad gang rung du grub par thal/ khyod dang phung po rdzas su yod pa'i phyir/ dper na khyod rang gzugs sems gnyis brjod med du mi 'dod pa bzhin du rdzas su yod na brjod med du （ 24na ） 'gal ba yin no/ /gang phyir khyod/ chos can/ khyod rang bzhin gyis med par btags yod du grub par thal/ khyod yod khyod phung po dang rdzas gcig tha dad gang rung du brjod du med pa'i phyir/ dper na khyed rang bum pa rang gi gzugs sogs dang de nyid dang gzhan du brjod du med pas rdzas yod du med par btags yod du 'dod pa bzhin/ khyod kyi/ chos can/ dngos por med par thal/

phung po dang rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung du med pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dngos por grub na rdzas gcig dang tha dad gang rung du nges pa'i phyir/ dper na khyod rang rnam shes dngos por grub pa rang gi bdag nyid dang rdzas gcig cing*/ gzugs dang rdzas gzhan du 'dod pa bzhin/ de phyir ngar| shes bya chos can/ bdag gi ngo bo rdzas yod du med de/ gdags gzhi phung po dang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gcig tha dad dang rten brten pa sogs su'ang med pa'i phyir/ zhes dpyad na med pa'i don bsdu'o/ /'di ni chos can/ btags pa tsam du grub ste/ yod/ dpyad na med pa'i phyir| dper na mtha' bzhi las mi skye zhing skye bas skye ba btags yod du grub pa bzhin| shing rta/ shes bya chos can/ shing rta ltar bdag dpyad na mi rnyed de/ shing rta mtha' bdun gang rung du dpyad na mi rnyed pa gang zhig mtshungs pa'i phyir/ shing rta mtha' lngar med tshul bdag phung gi rigs pas grub la/ 'dir rigs pa gzhan gyis sgrub pa'-i ched du tshogs pa shing rta yin pa 'gog te/ 'khor lo sogs tshogs pa shing rta yin na tshogs tsam mam/ tshogs dbyibs gang yin/ dang po ltar na/ gal te/ 'khor lo sogs sil bur gnas pa'i tshe shing rta yod par thal/ shing rta yod/ de rnams tshogs tsam min pa'i shing rta med pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ shing rta'i yan lag tshogs pa shing rta min par thal/ shing rta'i yan lag med phyir te/ yan lag can gyi shing rta med pa'i phyir te/ tshogs tsam min pa'i yan lag can ni med/ de ni yan lag can du mi rung ba'i phyir/ dang po khas so/ kho na re/ tshogs tsam min gyi tshogs pa'i skabs kyi dbyibs shing rta'o zhe na/ dbyibs tsam shing rta'i yan lag tshogs pa'i dbyibs shing rta min par thal| rtags sngar ro/ /gzhan yang dbyibs gang yin/ tshogs dus kyi yan lag so so'i dbyibs sam/ tshogs pa'i dbyibs gang yin/ dang po ltar na ma bsgrigs dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi dbyibs dang khyad par med pa'i yan lag so so'i dbyibs de yin nam/

de dang （ 24ba ） khyad par yod pa'i dbyibs de shing rta yin/ dang po ltar na/ khyod dbyibs/ bsgrigs dus kyi shing rta med par thal/ bsgrigs dus kyi yan lag so so'i dbyibs med pa'i shing rta med pa gang zhig bsgrigs ma bsgrigs kyi yan lag so so'i dbyibs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med pa'i phyir/ rtags gnyis khas/ gnyis pa ltar na/ sngar gyi dbyibs rgyun min pa gcig phyis skyed par 'dod dgos te/ de ltar na/ da lta gal te/ ma bsgrigs dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi dbyibs rgyun ma yin pa de dang mi 'dra ba'i bsgrigs dus kyi 'khor lo sogs kyi dbyibs shing rta min par thal/ de 'dra snang rung ma dmigs pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ shing rta bsgrigs dus kyi yan lag so so'i dbyibs chos can/ khyod shing rta min par thal/ ma bsgrigs pa'i yan lag so so'i dbyibs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyod kyang der mi rung*/ mi 'dra ba'i khyod kyang der mi rung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar tshogs pa'i dbyibs shing rta'o zhe na/ gang phyir/ tshogs pa la brten pa'i bsgrigs dus kyi yan lag tshogs pa'i dbyibs shing rta ma yin par thal/ bsgrigs dus kyi dbyibs de tshogs pa la mi brten pa'i phyir te/ tshogs pa btags yod yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ gdags gzhi rdzas yod dgos pa 'gal lo/ kho na re/ ma khyab ste/ tshogs pa bden par med kyang de la brten pa'i dbyibs btags yod du grub bo zhe na/ khyod kyi/ bden med kyi rgyu la bden med kyi 'bras bu brten pa mi 'gal bar thal/ tshogs pa btags yod la dbyibs btags yod brten pa mi 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'dis ni/ bum pa'i gzugs sogs tshogs pa bum pa min par thal/ de de yin pa shing rta'i yan lag tshogs pa shing rta yin pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa la brten nas khegs pa'i phyir| skye ba/ bum pa'i gzugs sogs rdzas su med de/ de rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa'i phyir/ rtags sngar bshad zin to/

/de'i phyir/ des na/ bum pa'i gzugs sogs kyi dbyibs bum pa min par thal/ bum pa med pa'i phyir te/ bum pa'i rten rdzas yod med pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ yang sgras snga ma bsdus so// kho na re/ 'jig rten na shing rta la brten pa'i tha snyad don mthun rgyun chad du thal| shing rta'i tha snyad 'dogs gzhi'i shing rta med pa'i phyir te/ shing rta rnam bdun gang rung med pa'i phyir/ des na tha snyad de yod pa'i phyir shing rta rang bzhin gyis yod do zhe na/ skyon de khyod la yod kyi kho bo la med ces ston to/ / de ni/ shing rta chos can/ khyod dpyad na med kyang khyod nyid tha snyad skyon med kyi 'jug gzhi yod （ 25na ） par thal/ ma dpyad par rang gi yan lag la brten pa'i khyod grub pa'i phyir/ de nyid/ chos can/ khyod la yan lag can gyi tha snyad 'jug gzhi dpyad na med kyang yod par thal/ ma dpyad par rang gi yan lag la ltos nas khyod yan lag can tu grub pa'i phyir/ der/ khyod la cha can gyi zhes dang*| rang gi cha shas la ltos nas zhes sbyar ro/ /shing rta khyod la byed pa po'o zhes dang*/ rang gi blang bya len pa'i bya ba la ltos nas zhes sbyar ro/ /skye bo/ khyod la nye bar len pa po'i zhes dang*/ rang gi blang bya la ltos nas zhes sbyar ro//

tshogs tsam yan lag la sogs par 'dod pa'i rang sde gong 'og dag na re/ shing rta la sogs pa'i yan lag tshogs tsam nyid yin gyi de min pa'i yan lag can med de/ tshogs tsam las ngo bo tha dad pa'i yan lag can ma dmigs pa'i phyir| zhes zer zhing*/ de bzhin du cha can sogs la'ang de ltar zer ro/ / 'jig rten/ shing rta'i yan lag dang yan lag can chos can/ khyod med par thal| khyod kyi yan lag tshogs pa min pa'i khyod med/ khyod kyi yan lag tshogs pa khyod min pa'i phyir/ rnam bdun/ dpyad na med cing ma dpyad par grub pa'i 'jug tshul 'thad de/ de ltar bzhag na don dam rtogs pa'i yon tan yod cing*/ kun rdzob nyams pa'i skyon med pa'i phyir te/ btags tsam gyis ma tshim par btsal ba'i tshe ma rnyed pa la brten nas don dam rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ ma dpyad par tshad grub tu bzhag pas kun rdzob nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ kho na re/ 'di'i yod mi rnyed ces pa mi 'thad de/ shing rta rang bzhin gyis med kyang de'i yan lag tshogs pa rang bzhin gyis yod do zhe na/ shing rta/ shing rta chos can| khyod kyi yan lag rang bzhin gyis med par thal/ yan lag can gyi khyod rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir te/ khyod rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ snam bu tshig pa'i thal ba la rnal ma tshol cig shing rta tshig yan lag can rang bzhin gyis med na/ yan lag rang bzhin gyis med dgos te/ yan lag can rang bzhin gyis grub pa 'gog pa'i rigs pa la brten nas yan lag rang bzhin gyis grub pa khegs pa'i phyir/ shing rta tshig na de'i yan lag tshig pa bzhin/ de bzhin| shes bya chos can/ yang na 'di mi byed do/ /shing rta ltar bdag phung po'i nye bar len po dang*/ phung po bdag gi nye bar len par grub ste/ shing rta ltar bdag phung po la brtain nas btags pa'i phyir/ nyer len/ phung po bdag gi las dang bdag phung por byed pa por grub ste/ shing rta dang shing rta'i yan lag las dang byed pa por grub pa gang zhig

mtshungs pa'i phyir/ （ 25ba ） dngos yod/ bdag chos can/ brten mi brten sogs su rang bzhin gyis med de/ khyod rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ gang la/ bcings grol gyi gzhir gyur pa'i bdag de chos can/ ma rig pa'i dbang gis bden par bzhag gi rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste| phung po la brten nas btags pa tsam du grub pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ shes bya chos can/ bdag gi ba rang bzhin gyis med de/ bdag rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ rdza mkhan med na rdza bum mi srid pa bzhin/ de phyir/ bdag dang bdag gi ba bden med du sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa chos can/ 'khor ba las grol bar 'gyur te/ srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod byed kyi las sgom pa'i phyir/ bum pa/ shes bya chos can/ bum sogs chos bcu shing rta ltar dpyad na med cing*/ 'jig rten na grags pa ltar ma dpyad par grub ste/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad gnod med kyis bzhag pa'i don thub dbang bzhed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ shes bya chos can/ yan lag sogs kyi phyogs bcu ma dpyad par grub ste/ rtags sngar/ yan lag bum pa rang gi yan lag la ltos nas yan lag can du grub ste/ shing rta rang gi yan lag la ltos nas yan lag can du grub pa gang zhig mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rdza bum gyi yan lag gyo mo sogs rdza bum la ltos nas yan lag tu grub bo/ / rtags 'dra de bzhin du bum pa yon tan can dang*/ de'i ma ris sngo sangs sogs yon tan dang*/ bum pa mtshon bya dang lto ldir ba sogs mtshan nyid la'ang sbyar zhing*| des snam bu re lde sogs la'ang sbyar ro/ /der ma zad 'dod chags dang chags pa dang*/ me sreg byed dang*/ bud shing bsreg bya yin pa la'ang sbyar ro// de rnams/ bum pa'i yan lag can shing rta ltar dpyad na med cing 'jig rten na grags pa ltar ma dpyad par grub ste/ 'jig rten gyi tha snyad gnod med kyis bzhag pa'i don thub dbang bzhed pa'i phyir/ yan lag sogs su ma zad rgyu 'bras kyang ltos grub tu bstan pa ni/

gal te shes bya chos can/ rgyu 'bras bu la ltos nas grub ste/ rang 'bras skyed byed kyi sgo nas rgyur bzhag dgos pa'i phyir te| gzhan du rgyur 'jog byed med pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu rgyu la ltos nas grub ste/ rang rgyu las skyes pa'i sgo nas 'bras bur bzhag dgos pa'i phyir/ gzhan du rgyu 'bras rang bzhin gyis grub na/ gang las/ rgyu 'bras gnyis gang snga/ rgyu snga'o zhe na| rgyu chos can/ khyod kyi dus na rang 'bras grub par thal/ khyod rang bzhin gyis grub/ rang 'bras （ 26na ） khyod kyi ltos sa yin pa'i phyir/ yang 'bras bu chos can/ khyod rang rgyu'i rjes su 'byung ba min par thal/ khyod rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rang bzhin gyis grub na gsar skye 'gal ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu snga'o zhe na/ 'bras bu chos can/ khyod kyi rgyu med par thal/ khyod kyi sngar khyod skyed pa'i nus pa med pa'i phyir/ yang na/ dang po ltar na/ rgyu chos can/ khyod rgyur rang bzhin gyis ma grub par thal/ grub na khyed kyi dus na khyod rgyu yin pa'i ltos sa de yod dgos pa gang zhig de med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ 'bras bu chos can/ zhes rigs pa sbyar ro/ /'di bde'o/ /gzhan yang rgyus 'bras bu phrad nas sam/ ma phrad par skye?d/ dang po ltar na| gal te/ sa myug chos can/ khyed gnyis dbyer med gcig tu thal/ khyed gnyis phrad pa gang zhig tha dad pa mi rung ba'i phyir/ de brtag pa gnyis pas 'chad do/ /rtags phyi ma grub ste/ rang bzhin gyis tha dad pa la rgyu 'bras mi rung ba'i phyir/ de brtag pa gnyis pas 'chad do/ /'dod na/ khyod gnyis la rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba med par thal lo/ /gnyis pa ltar na/ so sor/ sa bon chos can| myu gu mi skye bar thal/ khyod myu gu dang 'brel med kyi gzhan yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ thams cad rgyu 'bras su 'gyur ro/ /gnyis po/ rgyus 'bras bu skyed pa mi 'thad par thal/

des phrad ma phrad gang rung gis sgo nas mi skyed/ skyed tshul gsum pa med pa'i phyir/ ci ste/ 'bras bu med par thal/ rgyus 'bras bu ma skyed pa'i phyir/ 'bras bral/ rgyu med par thal/ rgyur 'jog pa'i rgyu med pa'i phyir te/ 'bras bu med pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyod la rgyu 'bras rang bzhin gyis grub na sngar gyi skyon yod la/ ma grub na/ med par 'gyur bas chad pa'i skyon yod do zhe na/ gang phyir/ dbu ma pa chos can/ khyod la rgyu 'bras rang bzhin gyis grub pa la bkod pa'i skyon med de/ khyod rgyu 'bras rang bzhin gyis grub par mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten/ khyod la rgyu 'bras gtan med kyi skyon med de/ rgyu 'bras ma dpyad par grub pa khas len pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ nyes pa de khyed rang la'ang mtshungs te/ sun 'byin/ rgyu 'bras bden grub 'gog pa'i sun 'byin chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi phyogs snga rang bzhin gyis phrad ma phrad gang rung gis 'gog par mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar 'gog pa la gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ gang tshe/ des na chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi phyogs snga 'gog （ 26ba ） mi nus par thal/ khyed kyis de nyid gang rung gi sgo nas 'gog pa mi 'thad/ 'gog tshul gsum pa med pa'i phyir/ des na rgyu 'bras bden grub ma khegs so/ /gang phyir rang gi dbu ma pa chos can/ dam pas smad par bya ba'i chad lta can du thal/ rang la mtshungs pa'i ltag chod 'phangs nas bya byed la skur ba 'debs pa yin pa'i phyir dang*| chos sngar/ rigs pa med pa'i dam bca' ma phrad na rgyu 'bras min par khas blangs nas bya byed la skur ba 'debs pa'i phyir/ yang na rkang pa gnyis kar la/ chos sngar/ rigs pa med cing rang la mtshungs pa'i ltag chod 'phangs nas bya byed la skur ba 'debs pa'i phyir zhes gcig tu bya'o/ /gang gi phyir/ khyod la chos can/ khyod sun ci phyin du rgol ba por thal/ rang phyogs bzhag tu med par gzhan phyogs 'gog pa'i phyir zhe na/

sun 'byin pas/ rgyu 'bras bden grub 'gog pa'i sun 'byin chos can/ khyod kyis rang gi phyogs snga 'gog mi nus par thal/ khyod kyis de rang bzhin gyis phrad ma phrad gang rung gis 'gog mi nus pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa la gnod byed min par thal/ khyod kyi khyab pa tshad mas kyang ma grub/ dbu ma pas khas kyang ma blangs pa'i phyir/ dang po grub stai/ des de don dam par mi 'gog kyang tha snyad du 'gog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ dbu ma pas bden grub khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ ji ltar shes bya chos can/ bden med la rtags dang rtags can gyi bya byed 'thad pa'i dpe yod de/ chu nang gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyad par mi 'dra bar dmigs pa las nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba yod par rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ nyi ma dang*/ bden med la rgyu 'bras kyi bya byed 'thad pa'i dpe yod de/ nyi ma dang chu nang nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan bden par med kyang nyi ma las nyi ma'i gzugs brnyan skye ba'i phyir/ rtags dang po grub ste/ de gnyis phrad ma phrad gang rung du mi bden pa'i phyir/ rtags de ni khos kyang khas len no/ /yang na rgyu 'bras la bya byed 'thad pa'i dpe 'di zur du ma byas na 'grel pa'i tshig la 'grig go /don la gnyis yod pa 'grel par gsal lo/ /mi bden/ bden med la sun dbyung bya dang 'byin byed kyi bya byed 'thad pa'i dpe yod de/ me long nang du dri ma can gyi byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan mthong ba la brten nas byad bzhin mdzes par bya ba'i phyir du byad bzhin gyi dri ma sbyong ba yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin 'dir yang*/ shes bya chos can| bden med la （ 27na ） sun dbyung bya dang 'byin byed kyi bya byed 'thad de| phyogs snga dang thal 'gyur rang bzhin gyis stong yang thal 'gyur gyis phyogs snga bkag ste gzhan gyi blo'i log rtog gi dri ma sbyong bar nus pa'i phyir/

dang po grub ste/ de gnyis rang bzhin gyis phrad ma phrad gang rung du med pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs ni/ bden med la rtags dang rtags can gyi bya byed 'thad de/ rtags dang bsgrub bya rang bzhin gyis stong yang rtags las bsgrub bya nges pa yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du rgyu 'bras kyi bya byed la'ang sbyar ro| |gal te rang*/ bya byed bden grub tu khas blangs pa la phyogs gnyis su bsdus nas 'gog pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa la 'phen pa'i 'bad pa don med de/ dbu ma pas bya byed bden par khas blangs na khyod 'jug kyang des de khas ma blangs pa'i phyir/ dngos rnams/ dngos smra ba chos can/ dngos po bden grub khas len par mi rigs te/ bden grub rigs pas sgrub par nus pa mi srid pa'i phyir te/ de'i dpe med pa'i phyir/ rtog ge chos can/ lung rigs ltar snang la brten nas bden grub sgrub par mi rigs te/ de sgrub pas bden 'dzin lhan skyes kyi steng du kun btags bsnan nas bden 'dzin 'phel te/ rang gzhan la gnod pa'i phyir/ khyod su zhig gi sbed 'jig rten sdug bsngal ba'i steng du 'ching byed kyi tshogs kyi dam du bcings nas rgyud 'khrug par byed ces pa'o/ /'gyur rnying du/ rtog pa ngan pa'i dra bas 'jig rten ci'i phyir 'khrug ces 'byung bas bcol zhes pa min gyi bcos zhes pa'i don to/ /sun 'byin lhag rigs pa med pa'i dngos po mtha' dag skur ba btab pa'i rtsod pa chos can/ khyod dbu ma pas dgag par nus te/ khyod btags yod du bsgrubs nas bden grub 'gog pa'i rigs pa sngar bshad gzhan la brten nas khegs pa'i phyir/ sun ci/ klu sgrub chos can/ khyod gzhan phyogs 'gog pa tsam yin gyi rang phyogs sgrub rgyu med pa'i sgo nas sun ci phyin du rgol ba por mi 'gyur bar thal| khyod kyis bstan bcos su dgag sgrub byas pa gdul bya thar pa thob ched du yin gyi rtsod pa lhur len min par bshad zin pa'i phyir dang*/

tha snyad du rang phyogs yod cing don dam par gzhan phyogs mi sel ba'i phyir/ lhag ma/ sngar bshad kyi rtsod pa las gzhan pa'i dpe rtags ma grub par 'gyur ba sogs kyi dngos smra ba'i rtsod pa chos can/ khyod sun 'byin ltar snang （ 27ba ） du grub ste/ khyod sngar bshad pa'i rtsod lan la brten nas sun 'byin ltar snang du rtogs nus pa'i phyir/ yang na/ bden grub bkag pa mi 'thad par rtsod pa'i sun 'byin lhag ma chos can/ zhes byas nas rtags chos 'dra'o/ /bdag med/ ston pas bdag med kyi dbye ba gnyis su bsdus nas gsungs pa chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ theg pa che chung gi rigs can grol ched du gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar/ ston pa chos can/ bdag med kyi dbye ba gnyis las mang bar phye ba la dgos pa yod de/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du skal ba dang 'tsham par de ltar phye ba'i phyir| spros dang*/ chos can/ gnyis las mang bar phye ste/ bcu drug tu spros shing bzhir bsdus te bshad pa'i phyir/ nyi shu'i dbye ba theg chen du bshad pa la dgos pa yod de/ theg chen gyi lam gyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i ched du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ mig chos can/ khyod bden pas stong ste/ khyod bden pas stong pa khyod kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ sna sogs dbang po lnga chos can/ chos rtags 'dra/ ther zug rtags grub ste/ khyod don dam par rtag mi rtag gang rung du ma grub pa'i phyir/ mig la/ dbang po drug rang bzhin gyis med pa chos can/ khyod nang stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod dbang po drug gi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gang phyir/ gzugs chos can/ khyod rang bzhin gyis stong ste/ rtags 'dra/ sgra dang*/ sgra sogs lnga chos can/ 'dra/ gzugs sogs/ yul drug rang bzhin gyis med pa chos can/ khyod phyi stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod yul drug gi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis char/ zin pa'i dbang rten khog pa rang bzhin gyis med pa chos can/

khyod phyi nang stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod zin pa'i dbang rten khog pa'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ chos rnams/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis med pa chos can/ khyod stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod chos nyid yin pa'i phyir| stong nyid de/ chos can/ khyod bden pas stong de zhes sngar ro/ /stong nyid zhes| stong nyid rang bzhin gyis med pa chos can/ khyod stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod de'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ stong nyid dngos po/ stong nyid chos can| khyod bden stong du bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod bden grub tu 'dzin pa'i log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir du der bstan pa'i phyir/ sems can/ phyogs chos can/ khyod la chen po zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod snod bcud kun la khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dang*/ yang*/ khyod byams pa chen po sogs dang mu mtha' med par 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod la （ 29na ） la bden pa'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa zhi ba chos can/ khyod rnam par thar pa'i sgo mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi/ gsum pa'i/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin shes nas srid pa'i phun tshogs la smon pa med pa chos can/ khyod rnam par thar pa'i sgo smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi /rnam thar/ snyom 'jug gi sgrib pa las grol bar byed pa chos can/ khyod rnam thar gyi/ stobs rnams/ shes bya thams cad thogs med du shes pa chos can/ khyod stobs kyi/ skyob pa'i/ dam bca' ba ltar brtan pa chos can/ khyod mi 'jigs pa'i/ so so/ stobs sogs gtugs pa med pa chos can/ so so yang dag rig pa'i rang gi 'gro la/ 'gro ba la phan pa sgrub pa chos can/ byams pa chen po'i/ sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can skyob pa chos can/ snying rje chen po'i/ dga' ba ni/ sems can bde ba dang ldan pa la dga' ba chos can/ dga' ba chen po'i/ btang snyoms/ sems can la chags sdang med pa chos can/ btang snyoms chen po'i/

sangs rgyas| 'khrul ba sogs kyis mi phrogs pa chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i/ ston pa chos can/ 'khrul ba sogs kyis mi phrogs te/ de rnams kyis thub par mi nus pa'i/ rnam kun/ shes bya thams cad mngon sum du mkhyen pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rang gi mtshan nyid yin te/ de'i rang gi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan ni/ nyan rang gi rgyud kyi mkhyen pa chos can/ shes bya thams cad cig car mngon sum du mkhyen pa min te/ nyi tshe ba'i yul can yin pa'i phyir| gang zhig 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid bden pas stong pa chos can/ khyod rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod de'i chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ da ltar ba/ dus gsum la mi dmigs pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ da lta ba rang gi dus kyi 'og dang 'das ma 'ongs da ltar du mi dmigs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir ram/ yang na/ chos sngar la/ dus gsum bden bar mi dmigs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ da ltar ba bden par mi dmigs te/ de skad cig gnyis par mi gnas pa'i phyir/ 'das ma 'ongs bden par mi dmigs te/ 'das pa da ltar zhig cing ma 'ongs pa da ltar ma skyes pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ bden na rtag tu yod dgos pa'i phyir/ mi dmigs| mi dmigs pa bden stong chos can/ khyod mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid yin te/ mi dmigs

（ 29ba ） pa chos can/ khyod rang bzhin gyis med de/ khyod don dam par rtag mi rtag gang rung med pa'i phyir/ dngos po rnams chos can/ khyod la rgyu rkyen 'dus pa las byung ba'i bden pa'i ngo bo nyid med de/ khyod rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i phyir/ des na rgyu rkyen 'dus pa las byung ba bden pa'i dngos por med pa'i ngo bo ni dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid ces bya'o/ /'dus par/ rgyu rkyen 'dus pa las byung ba'i bden stong chos can/ khyod dngos por med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin te/ khyod rgyu rkyen 'dus byung gi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po'i/ phung po lnga chos can/ dngos po yin te/ don byed nus pa yin pa'i phyir| de rnams phung po bden stong chos can/ dngos po stong pa nyid yin te/ mdor bsdu/ nam mkha' dang ma byas pa chos can/ dngos med yin te/ don byed mi nus pa'i phyir/ de nyid mkha' sogs bden stong chos can/ khyod dngos po med pa stong pa nyid yin te/ rang bzhin/ rang bzhin bden stong chos can/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin te/ 'di ltar/ chos nyid chos can/ khyod rang bzhin yin te| khyod sus kyang ma byas pa'i gshis lugs yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas/ de bzhin nyid chos can/ khyod la gzhan gyi dngos po zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de| kun rdzob las gzhan mchog tu gyur pa'i de kho na nyid du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dang*/ 'jig rten shes pa las gzhan 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kyi mngon sum du rtogs bya yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dang*/ yang dag pa'i mtha' myang 'das chos can/ chos 'dra/ 'khor ba las gzhan du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyis sgra gsum la 'jug te/ kun rdzob las dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i shes pa las dang*/ tshu rol srid pa las gzhan no de bzhin nyid sogs gsum bden stong chos can/ gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid yin te/

gzhan dngos kyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rab/ de ltar bshad pa'i stong gzhi dang*/ stong gzhi de dag bden stong yin pa'i rigs pa dang*/ stong gzhi bden stong du sgrub pa'i rigs pa rnams so/ /rang dgar byas pa min te/ sher phyin gyi mdo bzhin du bshad pa'i phyir/ de ltar srid gsum bden med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sa drug pa ba'i sems dpa' chos can/ kun rdzob tu 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug te/ bsam gtan mthar phyin la brten pa'i sher phyin khyad par can thob pa'i phyir/ rtag tu/ chos can/ 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug kyang 'gro ba skyob pa'i blo mi 'dor te/ snying rje chen po skyed par byed （ 30na ） pa'i phyir/ de gong*/ chos can/ gzhan rgyud zil gyis gnon pa'i shes rab myur du 'thob stai/ sa bdun pa myur du thob nas nyan rang blo'-i stobs kyis zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir/ kun rdzob/ chos can/ rang gzhan gnyis ka rgyal ba'i sar bgrod par byed de/ rang gzhan gnyis kas sku gnyis kyi rgyu phul phyin 'grub par byed pa'i phyir te/ snying rje dang sems bskyed kyi stobs kyis rang phyin drug la gnas shing*/ gzhan yang des de la gnas par byed pa'i phyir/ sa drug pa bshad zin to// //ga7 sems bskyed pa bdun pa bshad pa/ ring du/ sa bdun pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ chos nyid mngon sum du byed pa'i nus pa khyad par can thob ste/ chos nyid la skad cig re rair mngon sum du 'jug ldang nus pa'i phyir/ thabs kyi/ thabs kyi phar phyin lhag pa yin te/ thabs kyi phar phyin rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang 'dres pa mi srid pa thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ sa bdun pa bshad zin to// // ga8 sems bskyed pa brgyad pa bshad pa/ yang yang*/ chos can/ khyod sa brgyad pa la 'jug pa la dgos pa yod de| sa bdun pa man chad las tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa shin tu rgya che zhing myur ba sdud pa'i ched du 'jug pa'i phyir/

'di yi/ sa brgyad la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ smon lam gyi phar phyin lhag pa yin te/ smon lam gyi phar phyin rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang 'dres pa mi srid pa thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba/ chos can/ khyod sangs rgyas kyi zhi bar 'jug pa las 'dzin te/ khyod sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs ched du 'gog pa las sangs rgyas kyis slong ba'i phyir/ chags pa/ chos can/ khyed rang rgyud dag pa'i khyad par dang ldan te/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po thob pa'i sgo nas nyon sgrib kyi sa bon spangs pa'i phyir te/ rgyal bas 'gog pa las slong dgos pa'i phyir/ 'o na lam la 'bad pa don med de/ nyon sgrib zad pa'i theg chen pa yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ nyon mongs zad/ chos can/ nyon sgrib spangs pas 'jig rten las 'das kyang lam la 'bad dgos te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs ched du 'bad dgos pa'i phyir te/ rgyal bas 'gog pa las slong dgos pa'i phyir/ 'o na srid par skye ba mi len par thal/ des nyon mongs spangs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ srid par skye ba la rgyu dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs par byed mi nus par thal lo zhe na/ 'khor ba/ chos can/ nyon mongs spangs kyang srid par skye ste/ yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyi sgo nas srid （ 30ba ） par skye ba sna tshogs len pa'i phyir te/ dbang bcu thob pa'i phyir/ des na dbang bcu'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis rgya chen sogs pas sangs rgyas kyi chos rdzogs par byed do/ /sa brgyad pa bshad zin to// // ga9 sems bskyed pa dgu pa'i bshad pa/ dgu pa/ sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ stobs kyi phar phyin lhag pa yin de stobs ky-i phar phyin rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang 'dres pa mi srid pa thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ chos can/ sa brgyad pa ba las yon tan lhag pa yin te/ so so yang dag rig pa bzhi yongs su dag pa thob pa'i phyir ro/

/sa dgu pa bshad zin to// // ga10 sems bskyed pa bcu pa'i bshad pa/ bcu pa'i/ sa bcu pa la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ rang rgyud sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis rlab pa'i yon tan khyad par can thob ste/ 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur thob pa'i phyir/ ye shes/ chos can/ ye shes kyi phar phyin lhag pa yin te/ ye shes kyi phar phyin rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang 'dres pa mi srid pa thob pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ char sprin/ chos can/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i yon tan khyad par can thob stai/ gdul bya la 'bad med lhun grub tu chos rgya chen po ston pa'i phyir/ sprin las char bzhin no/ /sa bcu pa bshad zin to// //kha2 lam des thob pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ de tshe/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ so skye'i sa la med pa'i yon tan khyad par can thob ste/ skad cig re re la sangs rgyas brgya mngon sum du mthong bar nus pa sogs yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ bcu gnyis po gang zhe na/ de tshe/ chos can/ skad cig re rer sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal mngon sum du mthong bar nus te/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed rgyun ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du chos can dang rtags 'dra/ de dag skad cig re re sangs rgyas brgyas byin gyis brlabs pa ltar shes par nus te/ de nyid| der bskal ba brgyar skye ba bzung nas gnas par nus te/ sngon dang*/ der bskal ba brgya'i bar gyi sems can thams cad kyi snga phyi'i mtha' shes par nus te/ blo ldan/ der ting nge 'dzin/ brgya la 'jug ldang nus te/ 'jig rten/ der 'jig rten mi 'dra ba brgya g.yo bar byed nus te/ snang bar/ der 'jig rten mi 'dra ba brgya snang bar byed nus te/ de bzhin/ der rdzu 'phrul gyis sems can brgya smin par byed nus te/ brgya phrag der sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgyar 'gro bar nus te/ des ni/ der chos kyi sgo

（ 31na ） brgya sems par nus te/ thub dbang*/ der rang gi lus las byang sems kyi lus brgya ston par nus te/ rang gi skad cig re rer lus brgya sprul nas de re re zhing byang sems kyi 'khor brgya phrag re res bskor bar sprul nus te/ zhes sbyar ro/ /rtsa ba na rang gi lus la zhes 'byung zhing*/ lus brgya ston pa tsam la byas na zhing brgyar 'gro ba dang tha ma 'di gnyis kyi khyad par brtag dgos par snang bas dpyad do/ /blo ldan/ sa gnyis pa ba'i byang sems chos can/ sa dang po ba las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste| skad cig re rer sangs rgyas stong mthong bar nus pa sogs yon tan stong phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ sa lnga po/ sa gsum pa sogs lnga la gnas pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa gnyis pa sogs las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan 'bum phrag bcu gnyis sogs kyi sde tshan thob pa'i phyir/ de sgrub pa ni/ 'bum phrag dang*/ sa gsum pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa gnyis pa las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan 'bum phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ bye ba/ sa bzhi pa ba'i byang sems chos can/ sa gsum pa ba las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan bye ba phrag brgya bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ de yis/ sa lnga pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa bzhi pa las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ de nas/ sa drug pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa lnga pa las lhag pa'i yon tan thob stai/ yon tan bye ba 'bum phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ bye ba/ sa bdun pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa drug pa las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag bcu gnyis thob pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba'i/ sa brgyad pa ba'i byang sems chos can/ sa bdun pa las lhag pa'i yon tan thob stai/ yon tan de dag stong gsum 'bum gyi phra rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob pa'i phyir/ legs pa'i/

sa dgu pa'i byang sems chos can/ sa brgyad pa ba las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan de dag stong gsum grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i phra rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob pa'i phyir/ re zhig sa bcu pa ba'i byang sems chos can/ sa dgu pa ba las lhag pa'i yon tan thob ste/ yon tan de dag sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i phra rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa thob pa'i phyir/ ba spu'i| chos can/ chos sngar/ rtog pa'i kun slong med par ba spu'i bu ga re rer sangs （ 31ba ） rgyas grangs med pa re re zhing byang sems grangs med kyis bskor ba skad cig re rer rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan du ston par nus pa'i phyir/ 'di dang yon tan gyi sde tshan la zlos pa'i khyad par brtag dgos so/ /de bzhin/ chos can/ chos sngar/ de re rer 'gro ba rgyud snga ma 'dres par skad cig re rer ston par nus pa'i phyir/ kyang sgras brgya byin sogs ston pa'ang sdud de/ gang phyir| gsar du thob pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes chos can/ khyod gsar du rnyed pa'i gnas yin na 'og min yin pas khyab ste/ khyod gsar rnyed kyi ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ ji ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i tshe chos can kun dang chos nyid kun mngon sum du mthong bas khyab ste/ chos can kun chos nyid kun dang ngo bo gcig cing*/ chos nyid kun bden stong du dbyer med pa'i phyir/ snod mi 'dra yang de'i nang gi nam mkha' rnams 'dra ba bzhin no/ khyab pa yod tshul ni dper na so skye'i sgra 'dzin mngon sum gyis kyang sgra mthong ba'i tshe de dang grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i chos kun mngon sum du mthong ba bzhin/ des na chos can dang chos nyid kun rtogs pas kyang khyab stai/ mthong yang mi rtogs pa 'khrul rgyus yin la/ sangs rgyas 'khrul rgyu mtha' dag zad pas so/ /des na chos nyid mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig gis chos can dang chos nyid thams cad cig car mkhyen pas skad cig gcig la thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes so/

/gang tshe/ kho na re/ bden stong chos nyid yin pa dang sangs rgyas kyis ye shes kyis chos nyid mthong ba 'gal te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyis chos nyid mngon sum du ma mthong bar thal/ des chos nyid dngos su ma mthong ba'i phyir te/ de chos nyid kyi rnam ldan du ma skyes pa'i phyir te/ gzugs sogs rang bzhin gyis med pa nyid yin la de med pa'i phyir| khyab ste/ ye shes med nges kyi rnam ldan du skyes pa mi srid pa'i phyir/ kun nas| sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid ma mkhyen par thal/ de'i ye shes kyis chos nyid ma shes pa'i phyir/ khyod ltar blo yang skye med yin na/ mkhyen po/ bcom ldan 'das chos can/ khyod kyis gdul bya la chos nyid ston pa mi 'thad bar thal/ khyod la da lta de ston 'dod kyi kun slong rtog pa med pa'i phyir te/ khyed kyi blo rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir/ zhes sam/ khyod kyi blo yin na chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag pas khyab pa'i phyir zhe na/ gang tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ khyed tha snyad du chos nyid kyi rnam ldan du skyes par thal/ rang bzhin gyis skye med de tha （ 32na ） snyad du chos nyid yin pa gang zhig khyod tha snyad du yul dang mthun par rang bzhin gyis skye med kyi rnam ldan du skyed pa'i phyir/ ji ltar/ chos can/ khyed chos nyid kyi rnam ldan du ma skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis khyod kyis chos nyid ma rig pa min par thal/ khyod tha snyad du chos nyid kyi rnam ldan du skyes pa'i phyir/ dper na sngon 'dzin mngon sum bzhin/ de yi/ shes bya chos can/ kun slong gi rtog pa da lta med kyang chos nyid bstan nas don byed pa mi 'gal te/ chos sku'i mthu la brten nas longs skus chos nyid ston pa'i sgra las byang sems kyis chos nyid rtogs par nus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ longs sku chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag bzhin pa yin pa'i phyir/ sprul pa/ chos can/

chos sngar/ chos sku'i mthu las sangs rgyas kyi spyul skus chos nyid bstan pa'i sgra las gdul bya sna tshogs kyis chos nyid rtogs par nus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul sku zhes sngar ro/ /mkha'/ chos can/ chos sngar/ chos sku'i mthu la brten nas nam mkha' sogs las chos nyid ston pa'i sgra las gdul bya sna tshogs kyis chos nyid rtogs par nus pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ mkha' sogs rtog pa dang bral ba'i phyir/ kho na re/ da lta rtsol ba med na chos sku'i mthu las chos nyid ston cing don byed pa'i rgyu med do zhe na/ ji ltar/ da lta rtsol ba med kyang sngar gyi 'bad pa'i stobs las 'byung ba'i dpe yod de/ rdza mkhan gyis 'bad pa chen pos 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtsol ba med kyang 'khor lo 'khor nas rdza bum skyed pa srid pa'i phyir/ de bzhin| shes bya chos can/ da lta ston pa'i 'bad rtsol med kyang chos nyid ston cing don byed pa'i rgyu yod de/ med kyang sngon gyi smon lam dang gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang gis chos nyid bstan nas don byed pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ shes bya'i/ shes sgrib spangs pa'i sgo nas chos nyid la gnyis snang zhi ba'i ye shes chos can/ ye shes chos sku yin te/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ de tshe/ dri bral gyi chos nyid chos can/

'dus ma byas kyi sku yin te/ 'gog bden mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ sems 'gags/ gsar du rnyed pa'i sku gnyis chos can/ khyod rtogs pa nye bar zhi ba'i sgo nas mngon du byed pa'i gzugs sku yin na longs sku yin pas khyab ste/ khyod gsar du rnyed pa'i chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ yang na/ shes bya'i/ zhes pa sngar/ de tshe/ chos can/ chos nyid skye （ 32ba ） 'gag med pa la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin te/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ sems 'gags/ gsar du brnyes pa'i ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos can/ chos rtags sngar ro/ /'grel par/ chos kyi sku 'di ni de tshe skye ba med cing*/ zhes sogs la ye shes chos sku 'di ni chos nyid la gnyis snang zhi ba de'i tshe chos nyid skye 'gag med pa las slar ldang ba med pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ /lung 'di ni de yis longs spyod rdzogs zhes yang drangs pas chos nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa la 'grig go /zhi sku/ longs sku chos can/ zhi ba'i sku yin te/ rnam rtog dang bral ba'i sku yin pa'i phyir/ dpag bsam chos can/ rnam par mi rtog bzhin du gdul bya'i don byed de/ rnam par mi rtog pa bzhin du gdul bya'i 'dod don sgrub byed yin pa'i phyir/ dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu bzhin no/ / 'gro| chos can/ gdul bya'i don du yun ring du gnas stai/ 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du gdul bya'i don du bzhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di ni chos can/ khyod kyi dngos kyi gdul bya yin na dag pa'i gang zag yin pas khyab ste/ de yin na byang sems 'phags pa yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ yang na rkang pa dang po gsum la/ chos can/ rnam par mi rtog bzhin du don byed de/ de bzhin du 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar du gdul bya'i don byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa sngar ltar ro/ /thub dbang longs skus sprul pa'i rgyu mthun gyi sku chos can/

khyod la nus mthu'i khyad par phun tshogs dang ldan te/ khyod kyis rang gi sku gcig la sngar byung zin gyi skye ba kun cig car gsal bar ston nus pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyis sku gcig la rang gzhan gyi spyod pa khyad par can ston pa'i nus mthu dang ldan te/ khyod kyis sbyin pa la spyod pa'i skabs su sangs rgyas gang la bsnyen bkur byas pa dang/ zhing khyad par can na sangs rgyas bltams pa sogs kyi mdzad pa kun sku gcig la cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ de dag （ 33na ） chos can| khyed kyi sku gcig la gzhan gyis spyod khyad par can ston pa'i nus mthu dang ldan te/ zhing khyad par can na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dang spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ sangs rgyas de dag la nyan thos kyi 'khor ji snyed 'dus shing*/ chos gang gi nyan thos su 'gyur tshul sku gcig la cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ byang chub/ chos can/ chos sngar/ zhing khyad par can na byang sems kyi 'khor ji snyed 'dus nas chos ston pa sogs sku gcig la cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ der bdag chos can/ khyed kyis sku gcig la rang gi spyod pa khyad par can ston pa'i nus mthu dang ldan te/ zhing khyad par can deng bdag nyid rigs gang du skyes nas bslab pa gang zhig blangs te spyad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor bcas gang la rdzas kyi khyad par gang du ji tsam du tshad ji tsam phul ba sogs sku gcig la cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ chos can/ khyed kyi sku gcig la rang gzhan gyi spyod pa khyad par can ston pa'i nus mthu dang ldan te/ sbyin pa bzhin du phar phyin gzhan la spyod pa'i skabs kyi rang gzhan gyi mdzad pa kun sku gcig la cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ nyid spyod pa kun/ chos can/ khyed kyis rang gi spyod pa ston pa'i nus mthu khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod kyis ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu sngar bshad pa'i rang gi mdzad pa kun cig car ston nus pa'i phyir|

sangs rgyas/ chos can/ khyod kyis gzhan gyi spyod pa bstan pa'i nus mthu khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod kyis ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor ba ji srid du chos bstan nas sems can gyi don byed cing bzhugs pa cig car ston nus pa'i phyir dang*/ der dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sems bskyed nas byang chub thob kyi bar gyi mdzad pa kun mig 'phrul ston pa lta bur shes nas cig car ston nus pa'i phyir/ de bzhin/ chos can/ chos sngar/ der dus gsum gyi byang sems nyan rang skye 'phags kun gyi spyod pa cig car ston nus pa'i phyir dang dag pa/ chos can/ yul la dbang bsgyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ rdul che zhing 'jig rten chung bar mi 'gyur bzhin du rdul gcig gi khyon la 'jig rten thams cad shong zhing 'jig rten thams cad la rdul gcig gis khyab par ston nus pa'i phyir/ rnam rtog chos can/ dus la dbang bsgyur ba'i nus pa khyad par can dang ldan te/ khyod kyis srid mtha'i bar gyi spyod pa kun skad cig re re la ston pa'i grangs 'dzam gling gi rdul las mang ba'i phyir/ gnas dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos can/ khyed la dbye na bcu yod de/ khyod la dbye na gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs sogs bcur yod pa'i phyir/ rgyu gang*/ rgyu dang rgyu min gyi rab dbye ji bzhin du mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos can/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ rgyu dang rgyu min gyi rab dbye la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod dang*/ las kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i rab dbye zhes sbyar ro/ /las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i/ las kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bo'i rab dbye la chags thogs zhes sbyar ro/ / （ 33ba ） 'dod chags/ chags sogs kyi spyod pa la gnas shing mos la/

de las gzhan gyi spyod pa la gnas shing de la mos pa sogs ji bzhin du chos can/ mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i/ mos pa'i rab dbye la/ sangs rgyas/ mig sogs kyi rang bzhin nang stong sogs kyi dbye bas phye ba ji bzhin du/ khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i/ khams kyi rab dbye la/ kun tu/ kun byang gi dbang po'i ngo bo dang 'bras bu'i rab dbye/ dbang po'i mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i/ kun byang gi dbang po'i ngo bo dang 'bras bu'i rab dbye la/ lam 'ga'/ 'khor bar 'jug ldog gi rab dbye/ kun tu 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i/ 'khor 'das kyi lam gyi rab dbye la/ 'jig rten/ kun byang gi rgyur gyur pa'i bsam gtan rnam thar sogs kyi rab dbye/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang mkhyen pa'i/ gang las kun byang du gyur pa'i bsam gtan sogs kyi rab dbye/ ji srid/ 'das pa'i dus kyi rang bzhin gyi skye gnas kyi/ sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i| sngon gyi skye gnas kyi rab dbye la/ sems can/ sems can rnams kyi skye 'chi bzang ngan sna tshogs/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i/ skye 'chi'i rab dbye| rnam kun/ nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa zad pa ji bzhin du rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ye shes chos can/ zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs yin te/ zag zad kyi rab dbye la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'/ sangs rgyas yon tan chos can| khyod rdzogs par nyan rang dang byang sems kyis kyang brjod mi nus te/ khyod la tshad med pa'i phyir dang*/ khyod rdzogs par brjod pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi nus pa'i phyir/ dper na mkha' lding bzlog pa nam mkha' zad nas min gyi rang stobs zad nas ldog pa bzhin/ de phyir/ chos can/ khyod rdzogs pa zla grags kyi shes brjod kyi yul la'ang 'das te/ rang dbang du khyod kyi cha tsam yang zla grags kyi shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i phyir dang*/

khyod rdzogs par sa bcu'i byang sems kyi shes brjod kyi yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ 'o na 'dir brjod pa 'gal lo zhe na/ 'on kyang*/ zla grags chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rang dbang du cha tsam brjod mi nus kyang 'dir bstan pa la 'gal ba med de/ 'dir bstan pa klu sgrub kyis bshad pa la brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ zab mo/ bstan bcos 'dir bshad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan chos can/ gnyis su 'dus te/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i sku'i stobs （ 34na ） gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ zab dang*/ rgya che ba'i sku gnyis chos can/ khyod rgyu gnyis la brten nas thob stai/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam gnyis shes shing bsgoms pa la brten nas thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ slar yang*/ longs sku chos can/ khyed kyi gzhan don du mchog gi sprul sku ston te/ chos sku las mi g.yo bzhin du slar yang 'tshang rgya tshul ston pa'i phyir/ zhes sam/ sangs rgyas chos can/ khyod kyi mchog gi sprul skus gzhan don khyad par can byed de/ sna tshogs pa'i bsam pa can gyi gdul bya'i mos pa dang mthun par myang 'das su 'khrid pa'i phyir/ 'o na bshad zin pa'i sku las gzhan pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug yod dam med ce na/ gang phyir| shes bya chos can/ mthar thug pa'i thar par bgrod byed kyi spong lam de kho na nyid rtogs pa las gzhan med de/ dri ma mtha' dag zad byed kyi spong lam de kho nyid rtogs pa'i blo las gzhan med pa'i phyir/ khyab stai/ dri ma mtha' dag ma spangs na spangs pa mthar thug tu mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ chos rnams de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i blo la 'dzin stangs mi 'dra ba du ma med de/ de kho na nyid la ngo bo mi 'dra ba du ma med pa'i phyir/ de yi/ mthar thug pa'i thar pa mi 'dra ba du ma med de| mthar thug pa'i thar par bgrod byed spong lam de kho nyid rtogs pa las gzhan med cing*/ de kho nyid rtogs pa'i blo la rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma med pa'i phyir|
