des na mthar thug pa'i theg pa gcig tu grub bo/ /gsum du 'dod pa dag ni mthar thug pa'i thar pa la dri ma mtha' dag med pa dgos par 'dod kyang spangs pa dgos par mi 'dod do/ /'dir ni spangs pa mthar thug med na mthar thug pa'i thar pa mi 'ong zhing*/ spangs pa mthar thug sgrub pa la dri ma mtha' dag spong byed kyi gnyen por dgos la/ spong lam ni de nyid rtogs blo las gzhan med par bsgrubs zin to/ /'o na mthar thug gi theg pa gsum gsungs pa dang 'gal lo zhe na/ gang phyir/ chos can/ re zhig theg chen gyi snod du mi rung ba'i gang zag yod de/ snyigs ma lnga'i dbang gis sems can thams cad sgrol 'dod kyi mos pa dang mi ldan pa'i sems can srid pa'i phyir/ bde gshegs| re zhig theg chen gyi snod min pa'i sems can yod kyang sangs rgyas rnams gdul bya rnam grol la 'god pa dus las mi 'da' ste/ sangs rgyas rnams sems can thams cad （ 34ba ） sdug bsngal las sgrol bar 'dod/ sgrol ba'i thabs shes rang nyid kyis sgrol bar dam bcas pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sangs rgyas rnams dam bcas pa'i don dus las mi 'da' bar theg chen las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis kyang nges par sgrub pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ sangs rgyas chos can| nyan rang gi theg pa gnyis gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/ re zhig theg chen mi 'dod cing zhi ba la mos pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig drang ba'i ched du de gnyis gsungs dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i ched du de gnyis gsungs dgos te/ de dag theg chen la gzhug ched du myang 'das bstan dgos shing*/ re zhig theg chen gyi myang 'das bstan du mi rung ba'i phyir te/ de dag theg chen la 'jug pa'i gegs chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dper na re zhig rin chen gling du bgrod mi nus shing*/ lam gyi sdug bsngal gyis skyo ba la ngal gso'i ched du grong khyer sprul pa bzhin/ rnam par/ chos can/ theg chen logs su gsungs pa la dgos pa yod de/

nyan rang gi byang chub thob zin gyi gang zag kyang theg chen du drang ba'i ched du gsungs pa'i phyir/ bde bar chos can/ khyod kyis gzhan don du byang chub ston pa'i grangs tshad bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ khyod kyis gzhan don du byang chub ston pa'i bskal ba'i grangs dang rdul phra rab kyi grangs mtshungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang*/ chos can/ khyod kyis byang chub ston pa'i grangs tshad thams cad la bsnyad par mi rigs te/ de mi mos pa la bsnyad na nyes pa skyed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas nas gzhan don du ji tsam bzhugs snyam na/ rgyal ba/ chos can/ 'khor ba ji srid du gzhan don du sku tshe gnas te/ sher phyin gyi yum gyi mthar thug gi sras su 'khrungs nas thugs rje chen po'i ma mas skyong ba'i phyir/ bde gshegs chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la sems can kun la dmigs pa'i snying rje khyad par can yod de/ khyod kyi rgyud kyi sems can kun la dmigs pa'i snying rje de dug zos nyen par mthong ba'i bu sdug gi ma'i brtse ba las ches che ba'i phyir/ des na/ chos can/ khyod 'khor ba ji srid gzhan don du bzhugs pa'i rgyu yod de/ snying rje khyad par can gyi rgyu'i dbang gis der bzhugs pa'i phyir/ gang gi chos can| khyod thugs rje'i dbang gis rang don las ldog nas 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs te/ de'i dbang gis sdug bsngal can gyi sems can yod pa de srid du bzhugs pa gang zhig （ 35na ） 'khor ba ji srid sdug bsngal can gyi sems can gnas pa'i phyir te/ de srid rtag chad kyi lta ba gang rung gis bde 'gro dang*/ ngan 'gro gang rung gi sdug bsngal myong ba'i sems can yod pa'i phyir/ lugs 'di/ zla ba grags pa chos can/ klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos 'di rang bzos sbyar ba min te/ 'di nges don gyi lung don klu sgrub kyi rigs pas bkral pa ltar sbyar ba'i phyir/ 'di las/ khyod kyis bstan bcos 'dir bstan pa'i bden gnyis kyi 'jog tshul 'di rang rgyud pa'i bstan bcos na med de/

khyod kyi bstan bcos 'di rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa med cing btags pa tsam du yod tshul lung rigs la brten nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ dper na dbu ma'i sde snod las gzhan du bden stong ston pa med pa bzhin/ klu sgrub chos can/ khyod kyis dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos sbyar ba la dgos pa yod de*/ rtsa she'i don ji bzhin du rtogs ched du sbyar dgos shing*/ sbyar nas gdul bya'i re ba skong ba'i phyir/ de'i ched du sbyar dgos te/ 'ga' zhig gis rtsa she'i don khong du ma chud pa la brten nas klu sgrub kyi lugs bzang spangs pa'i phyir/ de nyid/ shes bya chos can/ dbyig gnyen sogs kyis de kho nyid ma rtogs te/ de rtogs pa la stong nyid la lhag par mos pa'i sa bon dgos pa'i phyir/ de phyir/ de kho na nyid gtan la 'bebs pa dbyig gnyen sogs kyi gzhung gi rjes su 'brang bar mi rigs te/ gong gi chos 'di'i phyir/ mu stegs kyi gzhung bzhin/ slob dpon/ zla ba grags pa bdag gis klu sgrub kyi lugs bzang phyin ci ma log par bshad pa'i dge ba ni/ rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs kyis gnag kyang dge ba rgya che zhing dkar ba ston ka'i rgyu skar gyis bskor ba'i zla 'od lta bu'am/ sems rgyud gnod pa'i rang bzhin yang sbrul gdug dang 'dra yang dge ba phan pa'i rang bzhin can/ gdengs ka'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba thob pa la brten nas sems can thams cad kyis de kho na nyid kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod par shog cig ces khengs skyung dang bcas te bsngos so/ /zla ba grags pa chos can/ khyod kyis bstan bcos brtsams pa'i dge ba bsngos pa yin te/ khyod kyis dge ba de rang gzhan kun gyi myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i

（ 35ba ） rgyur bsgyur pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba shes rab kyi don la tshul gnyis kyi sgo nas 'jug pa'i bstan bcos dpal ldan zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta theg le bum pa dang*/ lo ts+tsha ba pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis kha che'i dpe dang mthun par bsgyur cing*/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta gser gyi go cha dang*/ lots+tsha ba de nyid kyis nyi 'og shar gyi rgya dpe dang gtugs te bsgyur pa'o// // ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/ phul byung gzhung kun nyung ngur bsdus/ /don yod sbyong 'gror rnon po yod| |'di yi yin min gzhigs kyin rig /legs nyes re rer phye tshe shes| |blon rmongs mgo bo bskor 'dod tshos/ /gzhung lugs phul byung mun khung bcug /mgo rmongs blo gros bob bob tshos/ /'u thug 'gyur dus 'bru rdug bzung*/ /yin min ji bzhin mi rig bzhin/ /gzhan la 'chad pa skal ba ngan| |ji bzhin gzigs phyir yid gnyis zhi/ /gzhan la 'chad pa skal ba bzang*| |mkhyen brtse ye med bshes gnyen bsten/ /ma dad gzhan dbang nyan pa ngan/ /mkhyen brtse che brnyes bshes gnyen bsten/ /dad pas rang dbang nyan pa bzang*/ /phra rags mtshams rnams tha dad par/ /gnas ltar brtag dpyad yang dag byas/ /skal mnyam gzhan la'ang phan pa dang*/ /rang la phan bsam 'bad pa lags/ /dge des theg chen ye shes che/ /snying gi dkyil der chil chil 'khyil/ /grol 'dod blo rnon grogs mchog thob/ /myur du dus gsum drungs phyungs gyur// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge'i gsung*/ dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad/ -PAGE 522--PAGE 521-
